description: AKASRA Space is a Cambodia-born space innovation initiative founded by Lydet Pidor, driven by a vision to empower the next generation of space innovators. Starting as a one-person team, I aim to explore how satellite data, AI, and Earth observation can address real-world challenges, beginning with flood resilience in Cambodia. I welcome passionate collaborators in Earth science, AI, software development, data analytics, and design to help turn ambitious ideas into meaningful solutions.
